remarks: Sophisticated townhome just blocks from the village, train & park! Experience in-town living in this beautifully built, four bedroom townhome. Enjoy four finished levels of sun-filled rooms and hardwood floors. This unique home boasts an open floor plan, family room with fireplace, beautifully designed kitchen with all of the amenities and French doors opening to private patio and lush yard. Master bedroom with fireplace, elegant master bath with soaking tub and shower. The home offers four bedrooms, four and a half baths. Fully finished walk out basement with cutstom cabinets potential 2nd office / in-law suite. Two car garage & lawn sprinkler & security system.
